Description:
Functional Features:This scene depicts a single-story modular industrial building. Functionally, it serves as a small production workshop, warehouse, or auxiliary office space, suitable for light industrial operations, logistics transit, and temporary offices. Its open layout and orderly design support flexible zoning, and the overhead mounting structure facilitates equipment installation for high practicality. 
Visual Features: Visually, the exterior is dominated by orange-yellow and white tones, with matte orange-yellow panels on the upper half and white brick-like finishes on the lower half. The interior features dark blue matte floor tiles and overhead industrial pendant lights, paired with a weathered dark gray metal roof. The overall style is concise and bright, combining industrial and modern aesthetics with clean, unadorned surface treatment.

Functional Features:This object is a modular metal mesh fence. Functionally, it serves as industrial equipment protection, warehouse area division, workshop safety isolation, or temporary enclosure, suitable for factory workshops, logistics warehouses, and industrial production lines. It features flexible assembly, quick disassembly, safety protection, and space zoning, allowing adjustable enclosure ranges to ensure operational safety and area management.
Visual Features: Visually, it is entirely white, with metal frames paired with mesh panels. The structure consists of standardized columns and panel modules with a matte finish, presenting a clean, industrial modular design with simple and orderly lines.

Functional Features:This object is a modular prefabricated building model. Functionally, it serves as temporary storage, an exhibition hall, an outdoor event venue, or an emergency space, suitable for trade shows, outdoor activities, and temporary offices. It features quick assembly, flexible disassembly, and expandable space, adapting to short-term usage needs in various scenarios. 
Visual Features: Visually, it is dominated by light gray and white, with semi-transparent grid side windows and top skylights. The sloped roof exposes white truss structures at the front, with a matte finish, presenting a minimalist and modern style that combines transparency and industrial design aesthetics.

Functional Features:This scene depicts a large multi-story industrial building. Functionally, it serves as an old industrial factory, warehouse, or renovated public space, suitable for industrial heritage reuse, retro film/TV scene construction, large-scale warehousing, or creative offices. Its large-span lighting design and orderly layout meet diverse needs for long-term storage, production operations, or public activities. 
Visual Features: Visually, the exterior wall is made of weathered brown metal panels with obvious rust and wear, paired with rows of grid-patterned glass windows. The interior floor features dark gray stone tiles with red veining, presenting a heavy, retro industrial style with calm tones and realistic surface treatment, highlighting the aged texture of old industrial architecture.

Functional Features:This object is a single-story industrial-style building model. Functionally, it serves as a warehouse, small production workshop, or community auxiliary building, applicable to industrial sites, old block renovation, or game/film scene construction, with low-cost, easily modifiable general-purpose space attributes. 
Visual Features: Visually, the building is a regular cuboid: the exterior wall is mainly light mint-green paint, with red brick plinths and top trims, and dark gray corrugated metal panels in the middle. The light gray flat roof features rust-colored metal railings; the wall has multiple metal grid windows, with partial faded color-striped awnings. The weathered materials present an aged, realistic industrial texture.

Functional Features:This scene depicts an old single-story red brick industrial factory building. Functionally, it serves as a warehouse, small production workshop, or a carrier for industrial renovation projects, suitable for old industrial area redevelopment, retro film/TV scene construction, and art studio conversion. Its high side windows and large roller doors adapt to cargo transportation and lighting needs, featuring low-cost renovation and flexible utilization.
Visual Features: Visually, the exterior wall is red brick, paired with weathered blue steel roller doors. The side walls have multi-pane glass windows with rusted metal frames, showing stains and aging marks. The roof is dark gray tiled, with realistic surface treatment, presenting an aged industrial texture dominated by red, gray, and blue tones, with a rugged and retro style.

Functional Features:This scene depicts a large industrial factory building. Functionally, it is a versatile space for warehousing, large-scale manufacturing, or logistics transit, featuring an open, unobstructed interior and expandable structure. It adapts to industrial production, e-commerce warehousing, and film/TV scene construction, accommodating heavy equipment operations and bulk cargo storage. 
Visual Features: Visually, the interior is dominated by silver-gray steel columns and light gray concrete floors marked with yellow dividing lines, complemented by a mezzanine with yellow railings and large glass windows, presenting a clean, orderly industrial texture. The exterior model is a pure white mockup with a smooth matte finish, showing the factory outline with roof lighting structures and sharp, modern lines.
